arStrings.szText: {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} dooms enemies below {c_number}[75|%|]{/c} Life, maintaining the {c_important}{u}Hex{/u}{/c} and dealing {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} of {c_important}Doom's{/c} damage every second until they die. {c_important}Doom{/c} deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
